claims.text: A fresh cached response reduces latency and network overhead
claims.quote: A fresh response can therefore reduce both latency and network overhead each time the cache reuses it.

claims.text: max-age marks a response stale after the given number of seconds
claims.quote: The max-age response directive indicates that the response is to be considered stale after its age is greater than the specified number of seconds.

The no-cache response directive, in its unqualified form (without an argument), indicates that the response MUST NOT be used to satisfy any other request without forwarding it for validation and receiving a successful response
The no-store response directive indicates that a cache MUST NOT store any part of either the immediate request or the response and MUST NOT use the response to satisfy any other request.
The "Cache-Control" header field is used to list directives for caches along the request/response chain.
